grep -qFf /tmp/host-key.pub /home/node/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null && cat /tmp/host-key.pub >> /home/node/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /home/node/.ssh/authorized_keys; if [ ! -f /home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy ] && [ -f /home/node/.claude/ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy ]; then cp /home/node/.claude/ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy* /home/node/.ssh/ && rm -f /home/node/.claude/ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy /home/node/.claude/ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy.pub; fi; chmod 600 /home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 644 /home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy.pub 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f /home/node/.ssh/config ]; then sed -i "s#/home/node/.claude/ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy#/home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy#g" /home/node/.ssh/config; fi; if [ -f /home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy ]; then if ! grep -q "^Host github.com-loopdive-js2wasm$" /home/node/.ssh/config 2>/dev/null; then printf "%s\n" "" "Host github.com-loopdive-js2wasm" "  HostName github.com" "  User git" "  IdentityFile /home/node/.ssh/github-loopdive-js2wasm-deploy" "  IdentitiesOnly yes" >> /home/node/.ssh/config; fi; chmod 600 /home/node/.ssh/config; fi; sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -p 2222 2>/dev/null || true; sudo chown -R node:node /workspace/node_modules /home/node/.codex 2>/dev/null; if [ ! -d /workspace/node_modules/.pnpm ]; then cd /workspace && npm install; fi; cd /workspace && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/compiler-bundle.mjs --external:typescript 2>/dev/null; find /home/node/.claude/plugins -name "*.sh" -exec chmod +x {} + 2>/dev/null; tmux new-session -d -s claude 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs && ([ -f /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs/cert.pem ] || openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs/key.pem -out /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs/cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj "/CN=ttyd" 2>/dev/null); ttyd -W -S -C /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs/cert.pem -K /home/node/.claude/ttyd-certs/key.pem -p 7681 -I /workspace/.devcontainer/ttyd-index.html -t "theme={\"background\":\"#1e1e2e\"}" tmux attach -t claude &
postCreateCommand:
mkdir -p ~/.claude && echo '#!/bin/bash
tmux new-session -A -s claude "$@"' > ~/.claude/tmux-wrapper.sh && chmod +x ~/.claude/tmux-wrapper.sh && mkdir -p ~/.claude/projects/-workspace && sudo chown -R node:node /home/node/.claude/projects 2>/dev/null; ln -sfn /workspace/.claude/memory ~/.claude/projects/-workspace/memory && sudo chown -R node:node /workspace/node_modules /home/node/.codex 2>/dev/null; git lfs install; cd /workspace && pnpm install
